schema_note: 15 Oct 2026 (audit M10): two roles and fixture/style/hero hashes per 02_documentation/05 section 5.1 and RD-46. The agent writes only the stub (approved=false everywhere). Approvers record decisions in the RD-17 approval service; the RUNNER (never the agent) verifies identities and the signature against that service, then runs estimate_and_gate.py --verify-approval for the hash and role checks. storyboard/** is Edit-denied to the agent.
script_sha256: <64 hex of the approved script; read by 06_prompts_and_templates/brief_template.md>

approvers.scope: science fit with the approved script and fixtures

style_hash: <64 hex of the style guide file at the pinned version>
hero_hash: <64 hex of the hero reference image, or not_applicable when no panel has a hero_ref>
authentication: local JSON is not authentication; each approver identity and the signature are verified by the runner against the RD-17 approval service, never by the agent
